title: Advancebook
description: write and do everything for the book
body:
Advanced Book and Quill is a lightweight Fabric mod that enhances the vanilla Writable Book with expanded functionality.

Features:

10,000 pages instead of vanilla 100 pages
Colored text with RGB color picker (adjust Red, Green, Blue values)
Font size adjustment (A- to decrease, A+ to increase from 8px to 20px)
Symbol insertion - add special characters and decorative symbols
Clean interface with intuitive button controls
Crafting Recipe:

Writable Book + Feather + Diamond = Advanced Book and Quill
Supported Languages:

English (US)
Русский (Russian)
Français (French)
Deutsch (German)
中文 (Chinese Simplified)
Technical Details:

Version: AdvanceBook
Minecraft: 1.20.4
Fabric API required
Java 17+

Future Plans:

Support for additional Minecraft versions (1.20.1, 1.21+)
Bookmark system for quick page navigation
Text formatting options (bold, italic)
Save/export book content capabilities
Performance optimizations
